description: This file defines a PHP class 'EC2InstanceConnectClient' within the 'Aws\EC2InstanceConnect' namespace. It extends the 'AwsClient' class and provides methods for interacting with the AWS EC2 Instance Connect service, including sending SSH public keys and serial console SSH public keys, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: EC2InstanceConnectClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with AWS EC2 Instance Connect service. It provides methods to send SSH public keys and serial console SSH public keys to EC2 instances, both synchronously and asynchronously.

methods.name: sendSSHPublicKey
methods.description: Sends an SSH public key to the specified EC2 instance.

methods.name: sendSSHPublicKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SSH public key to the specified EC2 instance.

methods.name: sendSerialConsoleSSHPublicKey
methods.description: Sends an SSH public key to the EC2 serial console.

methods.name: sendSerialConsoleSSHPublicKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SSH public key to the EC2 serial console.
